screen.gameforge_runtime.help_1: 1. Place the Runtime JAR and generated project JARs in the same mods folder.
screen.gameforge_runtime.help_2: 2. Enter a world and press G to browse project content with search and categories.
screen.gameforge_runtime.help_3: 3. Select an item to inspect stats, view its recipe and obtain it; entities can be spawned directly.
screen.gameforge_runtime.help_4: 4. Multiplayer requires matching Runtime and project JARs on both client and server.
screen.gameforge_runtime.help_5: 5. Keep only the newest JAR for a project to avoid duplicate namespace conflicts.
